label: 权威状态 / State authority
description: Identify which component may decide each business fact and distinguish its projections under the agreed architecture.

label: 完成语义 / Completion semantics
description: Explain what an acknowledgement or completion label proves, and what remains pending in this scenario.

label: 预留生命周期 / Reservation lifecycle
description: Track stable, bounded reservations through consumption, release and unresolved execution without double use.

label: 分层幂等 / Idempotency
description: Connect a stable scoped identity and payload to one business effect; distinguish transport retries from new executable operations.

label: 权威命令顺序 / Command ordering
description: Resolve conflicting operations from the declared durable order rather than arrival timestamps or lock scheduling.

label: 数量与资金守恒 / Quantity conservation
description: Use exact quantities and explicit fee or rounding accounts to explain conservation through each relevant transition.

label: 风险池边界 / Risk-pool boundaries
description: Identify the funds and positions legally sharing risk; require explicit committed transfers or membership changes.

label: 风险估值语义 / Risk valuation
description: Distinguish equity, unrealized PnL, initial margin, maintenance margin and executable price under the stated product rules.

label: 风险输入一致性 / Risk snapshot consistency
description: Bind a decision to compatible balance, position, price and rule versions rather than arbitrary latest values.

label: 执行资格与接管 / Execution authority
description: Explain when a workflow may act, revalidate its authority and prevent old or concurrent actors from increasing risk.

label: 超时未知态 / Timeout semantics
description: Separate missing acknowledgement from proven non-execution and preserve unresolved obligations until evidence closes them.

label: 规范链与最终性 / Finality
description: Separate block-specific provisional observations from results accepted under an explicitly trusted chain finality policy.

label: 围栏能力边界 / Fencing boundaries
description: Use current epochs to reject stale authoritative writes without claiming they revoke external capabilities or signed bytes.

label: 数据流连续前缀 / Feed continuity
description: Prove a complete applied prefix in the correct source namespace; distinguish largest seen from last contiguous progress.

label: 有界恢复与降级 / Bounded recovery
description: Bound buffering and retries, identify a trustworthy restart boundary and label unavailable or stale output honestly.

label: 执行时约束 / Execution constraints
description: Enforce authorized price, amount, expiry and recipient constraints where execution occurs rather than only during quoting.

label: 授权范围与重放 / Authorization scope
description: Separate authentication, spending approval and execution permission; bind intent to domain, payload and replay state.

label: 并发状态所有权 / Concurrency ownership
description: Protect the complete mutable object graph and business transition, not just individual map operations or fields.

label: 可靠提交边界 / Durable commit
description: Identify the recoverable commit point and resolve ambiguous commits before publishing or advancing dependent work.

label: 业务效果原子性 / Atomic effects
description: Commit the applicable business changes, deduplication and progress together within a declared transactional boundary.

label: 可解释恢复重放 / Recovery replay
description: Recover a verified committed prefix with enough state and rule versions to replay without new business effects.

label: 同切点对账 / Reconciliation
description: Compare authoritative records at compatible cutoffs, classify differences and use auditable repair rather than overwrite balances.

label: 有条件的架构取舍 / Trade-off reasoning
description: Compare designs against stated custody, trust, latency and failure requirements without claiming one universal winner.

label: 证据与结论边界 / Evidence boundaries
description: Separate hypothetical design, hand reasoning, tests and measured results; do not infer employment history or production validation.
